title: bug: PowerShell 5.1 reads UTF-8 .moe-agent.json non-ASCII serenaProject using ANSI encoding
description: Get-Content -Raw -Path $moeAgentConfig (and with -LiteralPath) omits -Encoding UTF8. A BOM-less UTF-8 JSON serenaProject pointing at an existing directory containing é becomes mojibake on PS5.1 and falls back to project root with override not found; pwsh7 reads it correctly. Independently reproduced during task-3ad573a7; its fixture can use a BOM to isolate wildcard behavior.
definitionOfDone: PS5.1 honors BOM-less UTF-8 serenaProject with non-ASCII directory names.
Regression covers PS5.1 and pwsh7 reads without changing missing-path fallback behavior.
Keep literal-path binding from task-3ad573a7 if present.
